hero.title: Packages and experiences
hero.subtitle: Combinations designed for couples, families and groups: romance, nature, food and trails through La Mancha.

intro: Discover our combined proposals of lodging, dining and activities. Each package can be adapted to dates, group and tastes.

items.title: Romantic package
items.description: A couple’s getaway with a thoughtful extra, a La Mancha dinner and a private setting in which to switch off.

items.title: Family package
items.description: A stay for families with activities on the estate and gentle routes in the surroundings.

items.title: Gastronomic package
items.description: Authentic flavours of La Mancha: migas, stews, local produce and a sensory experience.

items.title: Trails and nature package
items.description: Lodging plus a tailor-made route through Campos de Montiel and the cultural surroundings.
highlights: We provide a personalised route dossier.

items.title: Shooting and country package (La Calerilla)
items.description: A shooting day at La Calerilla (driven or walked-up) with Bungalow Suite and Manchego cooking. Request the dossier: we do not publish prices.
highlights: 50 % deposit to confirm a hunting booking

items.title: Quixote and heritage package
items.description: A cultural getaway through La Mancha: Villanueva de los Infantes, Montizón, Torre de Juan Abad and Cervantine routes.

items.title: Intimate celebration package
items.description: Birthdays, anniversaries or family gatherings in an exclusive rural setting, with a menu and outdoor spaces.
highlights: Gardens and porch of the estate

items.title: Wellbeing retreat package
items.description: Yoga, mindfulness and self-care workshops in open country: a quiet space to reconnect body and mind in a small group.
highlights: Lodging and a setting in which to switch off

cta.title: Interested in a package?
cta.text: Mention it in your booking or get in touch so we can tailor the experience.
